ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-24-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, CSR: Brenda Fields, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo
Petitioner, Alfonso Cabansagan Jr. parent of Mary Barbara villanueva, a minor, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of name of the minor to Mary Barbara Cabansagan.
Decree signed in open court.
